_comment: Machine-specific addresses and expectations for the capture_watchpoint, disassemble_memory and press_sequence validation (scripts/validate_watchpoint.py, validate_disasm.py, validate_sequence.py, mcp_wds_e2e.py, mcp_bank_capture_e2e.py). Bytes come from the local MAME 0.289 ROM sets and were read with MAME itself; nothing here is a claim about other ROM sets or MAME versions.

ram.note: work RAM of the Z80; written continuously by the sound program

rom_unwritten.note: program ROM: the CPU never writes here, so a write watchpoint sees no event

disasm.note: idle loop in a,(1) / bit 0,a / jr z / ld a,$15 (bytes read from ROM)

ram.note: work RAM, written constantly in attract mode (the 0xC7xxxx range is battery-backed RAM the game does not write there)

disasm.note: level-4 autovector target: bra / bra / rte

input.note: active-low port: a field is 'pressed' when its masked bits differ from the idle value

disasm.note: RST 10h vector: push hl / push de / push bc / push af / jp $0196 (1- and 3-byte Z80 instructions)

bank_capture_expect.note: observed in attract mode on this ROM set: the per-frame handler runs with entry 0 mapped; the instruction after 'ld (hl),1' at 0x2BA0 runs with entry 1 mapped (first window byte 0x60)

read_range.note: video registers: after about 10 s of attract mode the CPU reads here with byte-lane accesses (upper 0xFF00 and lower 0x00FF) every frame

write_range.note: same registers: written with mixed byte-lane and word accesses every frame

word_read_range.note: work RAM: the first reads are full 16-bit words

disasm.note: polling loop; the maincpu has an opcodes space holding DECRYPTED instructions, so the program view holds different bytes here

bank.note: program map 0x8000-0xBFFF is a bank handler; 0xD003 is the qsound bank-switch write handler
